**Visual observations from test image:**
- Corn leaf (green, healthy elsewhere)
- Large, elongated tan/straw-colored lesions
- Dark brown borders around lesions
- Multiple lesions of irregular-elongated shape
- No pustules, no powder, no galls

**Reasoning:**
The elongated, cigar-shaped tan lesions with dark brown borders match Northern Corn Leaf Blight (NCLB) very well. The reference collage confirms this pattern — large, spindle-shaped tan-to-gray lesions running parallel to leaf veins with darker margins. This matches all key features in the test image. Other candidates like Gray Leaf Spot would show more rectangular, parallel-sided lesions, while Anthracnose would show smaller spots with distinct dark halos.
